invariants.rationale: composition reuses the single existing SWAP kernel and runtime
no file, format, parser, unit or path I/O is introduced in the production delta
ET demand, committed state, hydraulic capacity, result and diagnostics remain explicitly typed and separated
surface evaporation adds no persistent column state
hydraulic view and detached capacity state are call-local temporaries, not persistent column state
no persistent heavy solver object is added; call-local copy/allocation cost is explicitly not claimed as throughput-qualified
runtime reads committed base state only and performs no commit or persistent mutation; failure paths have no authoritative effect
held-out A-B-A replay is deterministic and has no hidden evolving state
no day, month, year, midnight or fixed-duration assumption is introduced
no coupling-window duration assumption is introduced
transactional noninterference is preserved and no coupling-specific alternate kernel path is added
groundwater head/flux interface contract is unchanged
surface evaporation result is decomposition only; no second mass booking exists and accepted solver external top flux remains authoritative
groundwater interface sensitivity production is unchanged
composition invokes one scalar capacity evaluation and no additional coupled full SWAP solve
stateless call-local execution is functionally MultiSWAP-compatible; throughput/scaling remains deliberately unclaimed pending separate performance qualification
MODFLOW-cell tile composition and area fractions remain runtime/coupler concerns
deep-vadose component contract is unchanged
deep-vadose/direct-coupling transition mass handling is unchanged
runtime depends on abstract surface_evaporation_capacity_provider_t rather than the concrete B1.10 provider, preserving alternative-solver openness
the independently qualified F-PM06C process blob is reused byte-identically with existing ET and hydraulic interfaces
runtime uses committed hydraulic-view and capacity contracts and has no HeadCalc-internal dependency
physical scope stays frozen at SWINTER=0 and SWREDU=0 and no numerical policy silently changes physics
bounded local algebra plus one capacity evaluation is introduced; retry/fallback policy is unchanged and copy-cost optimization is deferred
reference behavior remains available and the real canonical B1.10 capacity provider is exercised by an independent held-out oracle
status, route, ponding classification, capacity status, process status and raw signed capacity are explicit runtime diagnostics
no optional persistent state is allocated per column; activation remains an external runtime composition concern
surface-process composition is implemented in runtime and does not teach the kernel about tiles, MODFLOW or system composition
no hidden file, calendar, midnight, direct MODFLOW or one-day dependency is introduced
all architecture invariants are explicitly audited in this qualification
